# Clayground.Lab — block catalog

One line per type, from the `\brief` of its qdoc block. The brief says
what a block is for; the file it names carries the full qdoc body (every
property and verb, and how to wire it). Read the file before using a block
for the first time; the skill does not repeat it.

## Kernel — the clock, parameters, probes, scenarios and the run record

- **`BudgetBar`** — Shows how one total splits into its parts. — `plugins/clay_lab/BudgetBar.qml`
- **`DataRecorder`** — Records a run as a citable run record (or as plain CSV). — `plugins/clay_lab/DataRecorder.qml`
- **`Lab`** (singleton) — Global registry connecting parameters, probes and the sim clock. — `plugins/clay_lab/Lab.qml`
- **`LabPrefs`** (singleton) — The handful of settings that must outlive a reload, and where they go. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabPrefs.qml`
- **`LabView`** (singleton) — Session-wide view state - currently, whether the HUD is out of the way. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabView.qml`
- **`ParamPanel`** — Auto-generated slider panel for all registered parameters. — `plugins/clay_lab/ParamPanel.qml`
- **`Parameter`** — A named, ranged lab parameter, auto-registered with Lab. — `plugins/clay_lab/Parameter.qml`
- **`Plot2D`** — Live time-series plot of probe samples: lines, scatter, uncertainty bands. — `plugins/clay_lab/Plot2D.qml`
- **`Probe`** — A named observable sampled by the SimClock, auto-registered with Lab. — `plugins/clay_lab/Probe.qml`
- **`Scenario`** — A named, scripted lab situation, used inside a ScenarioSet. — `plugins/clay_lab/Scenario.qml`
- **`ScenarioSet`** — Declarative collection of scenarios wiring the scenarios()/applyScenario() convention. — `plugins/clay_lab/ScenarioSet.qml`
- **`SimClock`** — Seeded simulation clock driving deterministic probe sampling. — `plugins/clay_lab/SimClock.qml`

## Theme and language — tokens, palettes, dictionaries and their switches

- **`LabLang`** (singleton) — Runtime language switch for labs: dictionaries, lookup and number format. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabLang.qml`
- **`LabTheme`** (singleton) — Shared paper-and-ink design tokens for lab UIs, in light and dark. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabTheme.qml`
- **`LangSwitch`** — A row of language chips driving `LabLang`::lang. — `plugins/clay_lab/LangSwitch.qml`
- **`ScaleSwitch`** — Makes the whole lab larger or smaller: A-, the current percentage, A+. — `plugins/clay_lab/ScaleSwitch.qml`
- **`ThemeSwitch`** — A button that swaps the lab between the light and dark palette. — `plugins/clay_lab/ThemeSwitch.qml`

## Flow — the narrated walkthrough and what it points at

- **`Flow`** — A narrated walkthrough that drives the lab through its own mutation API. — `plugins/clay_lab/Flow.qml`
- **`FlowChip`** — The offer to be taught: starts a Flow, and says that it exists. — `plugins/clay_lab/FlowChip.qml`
- **`FlowStep`** — One stop of a lab Flow: what is said, what the lab does, what the learner does. — `plugins/clay_lab/FlowStep.qml`
- **`MarkLayer`** — Rings on the world points something is naming right now. — `plugins/clay_lab/MarkLayer.qml`
- **`Narrator`** — The learner-facing surface of a `Flow`: what is being said and where we are. — `plugins/clay_lab/Narrator.qml`
- **`SceneTitle`** — A title card over the whole picture: fades in, holds, fades out. — `plugins/clay_lab/SceneTitle.qml`

## Board — the build lab's parts, wires and cards

- **`Board`** — The store behind a build-type lab: typed parts on a grid, wires between their pads. — `plugins/clay_lab/Board.qml`
- **`BoardInput`** — The mouse on a `Board`: wire pads, select and drag parts, operate, erase, tap a wire. — `plugins/clay_lab/BoardInput.qml`
- **`BoardOverlay`** — The 2D readings over a `Board`: value labels, wire readings, watch marks and pinned tags. — `plugins/clay_lab/BoardOverlay.qml`
- **`BoardPalette`** — The build lab's top-left panel: presets, the parts to take, the tools - in foldable sections. — `plugins/clay_lab/BoardPalette.qml`
- **`BoardWires3D`** — Every wire on a `Board` as one flat instanced line batch, plus the dangling preview. — `plugins/clay_lab/BoardWires3D.qml`
- **`CardFocusRing`** — The ring a card's control wears while the keyboard is on it. — `plugins/clay_lab/CardFocusRing.qml`
- **`PartCard`** — The selection card: what is selected, what it reads, what you can do to it. — `plugins/clay_lab/PartCard.qml`
- **`PartPlacer`** — The palette's parts as ONE handheld tool that carries which part it is about to place. — `plugins/clay_lab/PartPlacer.qml`

## Chrome — panels, keys, hints, watches and the stage

- **`Compass`** — Which way the work surface faces while you circle it. — `plugins/clay_lab/Compass.qml`
- **`GridMode`** — Snap-or-free placement, with grafli's grid contract. — `plugins/clay_lab/GridMode.qml`
- **`HintBar`** — The bottom-centre line that says what you can do right now. — `plugins/clay_lab/HintBar.qml`
- **`HintJump`** — Keyboard selection: label every target, type the label. — `plugins/clay_lab/HintJump.qml`
- **`LabHelp`** — The key map, on screen, generated from a LabKeys. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabHelp.qml`
- **`LabKeys`** — The canonical lab key map, and the help text that describes it. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabKeys.qml`
- **`LabPanel`** — A titled paper panel - the surface every lab HUD is made of. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabPanel.qml`
- **`LabStage3D`** — The ground every 3D lab stands on: an endless sheet of squared paper, plus the light rig and the environment that go with it. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabStage3D.qml`
- **`ScenarioBar`** — Clickable preset chips, each carrying what it is worth noticing. — `plugins/clay_lab/ScenarioBar.qml`
- **`SelectionFrame3D`** — The shared hover/select language: a flat frame on the work surface. — `plugins/clay_lab/SelectionFrame3D.qml`
- **`WatchChip`** — Put this thing on the plot - the watch toggle, in three states. — `plugins/clay_lab/WatchChip.qml`
- **`WatchMark`** — The dot a watched object wears in the world, in its curve's colour. — `plugins/clay_lab/WatchMark.qml`
- **`WatchMonitor`** — Watch a thing, get a probe, a colour and a curve. — `plugins/clay_lab/WatchMonitor.qml`
- **`WorldLabel`** — A 2D chip pinned to a point in a 3D scene. — `plugins/clay_lab/WorldLabel.qml`

## Instruments — mounted readings: scales, faces, readouts, the dock

- **`BarFace`** — A level bar on an `InstrumentScale` - horizontal or vertical, with peak-hold. — `plugins/clay_lab/BarFace.qml`
- **`ColumnFace`** — A thermometer column on an `InstrumentScale` - every gradation labelled. — `plugins/clay_lab/ColumnFace.qml`
- **`DigitFace`** — The reading as mono digits - the numeric face of an `InstrumentScale`. — `plugins/clay_lab/DigitFace.qml`
- **`DockedInstrument`** — One instrument in an `InstrumentDock` - a titled panel the reader can put away. — `plugins/clay_lab/DockedInstrument.qml`
- **`Gauge`** — A needle dial that picks its own range - the instrument, not a number. — `plugins/clay_lab/Gauge.qml`
- **`InstrumentDock`** — A column of HUD instruments the reader can put away one at a time. — `plugins/clay_lab/InstrumentDock.qml`
- **`InstrumentScale`** — What a reading means - the measurement model every instrument face draws. — `plugins/clay_lab/InstrumentScale.qml`
- **`LabBanner`** — The centred status pill: something is wrong, or something just happened. — `plugins/clay_lab/LabBanner.qml`
- **`MiniMap`** — The abstract view: a fitted 2D projection of the scene, drawn by the lab. — `plugins/clay_lab/MiniMap.qml`
- **`ReadoutPanel`** — A titled panel of live readout rows, built from data. — `plugins/clay_lab/ReadoutPanel.qml`
- **`ReadoutRow`** — One line of a readout: swatch, name, live value. — `plugins/clay_lab/ReadoutRow.qml`
- **`RecIndicator`** — The recording dot: this run is being written to a file. — `plugins/clay_lab/RecIndicator.qml`
- **`TransportChip`** — Sim time, pause and speed - the clock, on screen. — `plugins/clay_lab/TransportChip.qml`

## Handheld instruments — what the viewer picks up and points with

- **`CameraAnchorMark`** — Shows where the camera turns and zooms: a dotted ring on the anchor. — `plugins/clay_lab/CameraAnchorMark.qml`
- **`HandheldInstrument`** — An instrument the viewer picks up, applies to the scene, and puts down. — `plugins/clay_lab/HandheldInstrument.qml`
- **`InstrumentBelt`** — What the viewer can pick up: the kernel's instruments in every lab, plus whatever the kit brought. — `plugins/clay_lab/InstrumentBelt.qml`
- **`Stopwatch`** — How long something took, in *simulated* seconds: click to start, click to stop. — `plugins/clay_lab/Stopwatch.qml`
- **`TapeMeasure`** — Clicked points chained into a run, with the length of every leg, the angle at every corner and the total on screen. — `plugins/clay_lab/TapeMeasure.qml`

## Camera — shots for a lab with a presenter

- **`CameraDirector`** — Which shot when, for a lab with a presenter in it. — `plugins/clay_lab/CameraDirector.qml`
